fact_text: Mint Rewards is a waste-recycling startup that gives households reward points for sorting and handing over their waste, and the points can be redeemed with partner brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said about 90% of Pakistan's waste goes to the informal sector or is never collected at all.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said only about 20% of the plastic that Pakistan produces or imports can be collected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said under 9% of the plastic Pakistan produces or imports is recycled, and open-air melting of plastic waste is more harmful to the environment than proper recycling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said 20 large Pakistani cities generate about 80% of the country's solid waste, so the company plans to target those cities first.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Households sort waste into dry streams (paper, plastic, glass, tin) and wet food waste, and bag them; the company collects weekly without booking and sends a notice one day ahead and two hours before pickup.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Collected bags are matched to the household that handed them over, and reward points for the weight collected are credited to the user's app and can be redeemed at once.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The company calculates the CO2 saved and landfill diverted from each household's collected weight and reports that impact back to the household alongside its points.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Reward partners include more than 202 brands, including Foodpanda, which gives Mint Rewards subscribers 50% off a Pro subscription, and Unilever, whose personal-care products carry discounts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Redemption offers cited were 30% to 50% off at various partners, some free items such as coffee and rides, and 75% off a streaming subscription for eligible users.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: After collection, materials are sorted by type, including plastic sub-categories, and aggregated before going to recyclers that follow international standards, and the company tracks where each batch ends up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The company does not run its own recycling plants because each material needs a separate plant; it relies on partner recyclers and plans to start its own recycling later, which the founder presented as a future step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder is an investment banker with about 24 years in the field who began venture investing at a corporate venture arm of a European bank and started a fintech company in 2015.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said the fintech was run for about seven years before he exited it, and the recycling idea came to him in 2018, with the company established in 2023.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said the company has met the Sindh Government, the federal Ministry of Climate Change, and the Punjab Government, which wants to integrate the model, and a solid waste management board is involved informally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder named awareness as the biggest challenge, both among households and among small businesses that must be shown that recycling helps them, alongside informal-sector players and regulatory hurdles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The founder said that with government, households and businesses on board, the model could be rolled out across 20 large cities and address most of their waste problem quickly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Mint Foundation is planned as a separate, independent entity with its own governance board, working with existing NGOs to run education and skills programs for children, and its setup was not yet complete.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: The planned programs split children into 5-10, 10-14 and 14-20 age groups, and the founder said work with children starts at 14 because younger children would be child labour.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: For 14-to-20-year-olds, the planned skills program covers technical, IT, vocational, soft and business skills for those who want to start their own business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: A ride-hailing company proposed a partner model in which collectors are taught addresses and mapping, trained to ride motorcycles, and helped to get licences, so they become riders rather than waste collectors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)

fact_text: Brand partners' HR and CSR programmes support the model, and the founder said that a brand partner's own HR and CSR activities help the company's efforts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investment Banker Turns Entrepreneur to Fix Recycling in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-26)
